args.message:
Use ROUND_HALF_EVEN in round_money per FIN-212

src/money.py's docstring already promised banker's rounding, but the
implementation used ROUND_HALF_UP, causing tests/test_money.py to fail.
Switch to ROUND_HALF_EVEN so 2.675 -> 2.68 and 2.665 -> 2.66.

args.body:
## Summary
Fixes the nightly build failure in `tests/test_money.py`, which expects banker's rounding per FIN-212.

The docstring in `src/money.py` already documented ROUND_HALF_EVEN, but the implementation imported and used ROUND_HALF_UP. This changes the rounding mode to ROUND_HALF_EVEN, so half-cent values round to the nearest even cent (e.g. 2.675 → 2.68, 2.665 → 2.66).

## Changes
- `src/money.py`: import `ROUND_HALF_EVEN` and pass it to `Decimal.quantize`.

## Testing
CI run passed on this branch (run `ci-0001`, commit 08d3cd5986), including `tests/test_money.py::test_half_even`.
